scenario: Concurrent score batches share one atomic daily reservation boundary and historical score attempts count toward the configured cap.

failure_before_repair.command: uv run --isolated --with-editable . --extra dev python -m pytest tests/test_scoring.py tests/test_score_sink.py -q
failure_before_repair.result: failed: two batches both called the provider after observing the same persisted count; DatabaseScoreSink had no reservation method

repair: Added a score_budget protocol and reserved each article immediately before provider invocation.
Added DatabaseScoreSink.reserve_score_attempt using the existing llm_daily_usage table and PostgreSQL row locking.
Folded historical article_base_scores attempts into the reservation effective usage with max(ledger, history).
Added a conditional PostgreSQL ThreadPoolExecutor test for cap=3 atomicity.
